summary:
Neither Benjamin Netanyahu's bloc nor Gadi Eisenkot's opposition bloc has a parliamentary majority after Tuesday's election in Israel. With 51.8% of ballots counted, Netanyahu's bloc had 55 of the 120 Knesset seats, short of the 61 needed. Both leaders pledged on Wednesday to form a government, and final results are expected tonight or tomorrow morning. The benchmark Tel Aviv 125 index fell more than 3 percent.

A high-speed train hit the back of a stopped train near Toledo in central Spain on Wednesday, derailing two cars and killing at least 10 people, authorities said. Some media reports put the toll as high as 39. In India, Cyclone Arnab made landfall near Narsapur in Andhra Pradesh, killing at least three people while authorities evacuated 180,000.

DR Congo has reported more than 10,000 Ebola cases and nearly 4,900 deaths, and the outbreak has spread abroad. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo virus, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. In southern Ukraine, a local truce in the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky began on Tuesday, with both sides ceasing drone attacks.

headlines.title: Israeli election leaves neither bloc with a parliamentary majority
headlines.summary: Israel's election on Tuesday left neither Benjamin Netanyahu's bloc nor Gadi Eisenkot's opposition bloc with the 61 seats needed for a majority. Both leaders pledged on Wednesday to form a government, and final results are expected tonight or tomorrow morning.

headlines.title: High-speed train crash in Spain kills at least 10 near Toledo
headlines.summary: A high-speed train hit the rear of a stopped train near Toledo on Wednesday, derailing two cars and killing at least 10 people, authorities said. Some media reports put the toll as high as 39, and service on the Madrid-Andalusia line was suspended.

headlines.title: Cyclone Arnab makes landfall in Andhra Pradesh, killing three
headlines.summary: Cyclone Arnab made landfall near Narsapur in Andhra Pradesh, killing at least three people while authorities evacuated 180,000. Crops on over 80,000 hectares were damaged, Chief Minister Naidu told Union Home Minister Amit Shah.

headlines.title: DR Congo Ebola cases pass 10,000 with no approved vaccine
headlines.summary: DR Congo has reported more than 10,000 Ebola cases and nearly 4,900 deaths. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo virus, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment.

headlines.title: Local truce takes hold in Russian-occupied Oleshky, Ukraine
headlines.summary: A local truce began Tuesday in Oleshky, a Russian-occupied city in southern Ukraine, with both sides ceasing drone attacks. It was brokered by Melania Trump to allow aid in and civilians out.

headlines.title: Flávio Bolsonaro leaves Brazil for Ecuador after election defeat
headlines.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro, who lost Brazil's runoff to Lula da Silva, entered Argentina before flying to Ecuador, Argentina's government said. Other outlets reported he was heading to the United States, where he and his family were granted visas.

headlines.title: Egyptian court orders independent news site Mada Masr closed
headlines.summary: A court convicted Lina Attalah, editor-in-chief of Mada Masr, of running an unlicensed website, fined her and ordered the site closed. The Committee to Protect Journalists called on Egyptian authorities to reverse the ruling.
